accepted.s: Swarna Andhra@2047 is primarily intended to provide the framework for which of the following in Andhra Pradesh?
o: The reorganisation of districts completed in 2014
The privatisation of all public-sector undertakings
Only the state’s municipal reforms up to 2030
accepted.x: Swarna Andhra@2047 provides the framework for the 2024–29 policies and industrial corridors in Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the precise scope of the vision instead of choosing an extreme or unrelated policy objective.
accepted.sec: Swarna Andhra Vision 2047 - principles and flagship goals

accepted.s:
With reference to the energy objective of Swarna Andhra@2047, consider the following statements:
1. Andhra Pradesh aims to achieve net zero emissions by 2047.
2. The objective is linked with the Integrated Clean Energy Policy and APSES 2024–25.
3. The target year for net zero is 2035.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The net-zero target is 2047 and is associated with the Integrated Clean Energy Policy and APSES 2024–25. Statement 3 is false because the target year is not 2035.
accepted.tq: Split the statements by checking the target year and the policy association.
accepted.sec: Swarna Andhra Vision 2047 - principles and flagship goals

accepted.s: The PanIIT Summit 2026 associated with Swarna Andhra@2047 is scheduled to be held at which place and on which date?
accepted.x: The PanIIT Summit 2026 is scheduled at Vijayawada on 3 October 2026 to shape a DeepTech roadmap for Swarna Andhra@2047.
accepted.tq: Use the place-date combination to distinguish closely related event details.
accepted.sec: Swarna Andhra Vision 2047 - principles and flagship goals

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT among the panels proposed for the PanIIT Summit 2026?
o: DeepTech, including quantum technology, semiconductors and AI
accepted.x: The five panels are energy and fuel-cost optimisation; DeepTech; space and defence manufacturing; BioValley; and agri-tech, water and blue economy. Urban tourism and heritage conservation is not listed.
accepted.tq: Find the option outside the specified five-panel grouping.
accepted.sec: Swarna Andhra Vision 2047 - principles and flagship goals

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the role of the Andhra Pradesh Industrial Infrastructure Corporation (APIIC)?
o: It regulates aquaculture farms, seed and feed throughout the State.
It functions exclusively as a foreign trade tribunal.
It administers only the State’s green-building certification system.
It is the nodal agency for industrial parks with plug-and-play facilities.
accepted.x: APIIC is the nodal agency for industrial parks and provides plug-and-play industrial infrastructure.
accepted.tq: Match the institution with its core administrative function.
accepted.sec: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

accepted.s: Since June 2026, APIIC has been empowered to allot industrial land up to what area directly, without Cabinet approval?
accepted.x: Since June 2026, APIIC can directly allot up to 50 acres without Cabinet approval.
accepted.tq: Check the exact numerical ceiling rather than the institution’s general land-allotment role.
accepted.sec: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the National Industrial Corridor Programme projects in Andhra Pradesh:
1. The Centre approved 12 new projects in August 2024.
2. The total number of projects after the approval became 20.
3. Orvakal and Kopparthy are the Andhra Pradesh projects identified under this programme.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: 12 new projects were approved in August 2024, taking the total to 20, with Orvakal and Kopparthy identified for Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Verify the number, resulting total and State-specific locations separately.
accepted.sec: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

accepted.s: Sri City, situated on the Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu border, is best described as a:
o: Government-owned single-product port in Srikakulam district
Pharmaceutical research city in Anakapalli district
Greenfield international airport in Vizianagaram district
Private multi-product Special Economic Zone in Tirupati district
accepted.x: Sri City is a private multi-product SEZ located on the Andhra Pradesh–Tamil Nadu border in Tirupati district.
accepted.tq: Use the combination of ownership, product range, location and institutional type.
accepted.sec: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

accepted.s: The Single Desk Portal of Andhra Pradesh has recorded a clearance rate of approximately:
accepted.x: The Single Desk Portal has recorded a 99.2 percent clearance rate.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the reported precise percentage from rounded or absolute alternatives.
accepted.sec: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

accepted.s: Andhra Pradesh was ranked first in the Business Reforms Action Plan (BRAP) in which of the following years or combinations?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first in 2016 jointly with Telangana, and in 2017 and 2019. BRAP 2020 placed it among the Top Achievers.
accepted.tq: Track the exact sequence of years and the qualification attached to the 2016 ranking.
accepted.sec: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

accepted.s: The State Investment Promotion Board (SIPB), chaired by the Chief Minister, approved in 2024–25 projects involving which of the following combinations?
accepted.x: In 2024–25, SIPB approved 8 projects involving ₹2,45,275 crore and 65,541 jobs.
accepted.tq: Keep the project count, investment and employment figures together as one numerical set.
accepted.sec: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

accepted.s: In June 2026, the Andhra Pradesh Cabinet ratified how many SIPB proposals, approximately worth:
accepted.x: In June 2026, the Cabinet ratified 87 SIPB proposals worth ₹34,000 crore.
accepted.tq: Separate the later ratification figures from the earlier 2024–25 SIPB approval figures.
accepted.sec: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched with the Rayalaseema industrial hub initiatives?
accepted.x: Kia is associated with Sri Sathya Sai district. Royal Enfield is near Tirupati, JSW Steel is in Kadapa, and the AMCA integration and flight-test centre is another initiative of the hub.
accepted.tq: Test the institution-location relationship and reject swapped locations.
accepted.sec: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about the Rayalaseema industrial hub:
1. JSW Steel’s Kadapa project has a Phase-I investment of ₹4,500 crore out of a proposed ₹16,350 crore.
2. A DRDO AMCA integration and flight-test centre is included among the initiatives.
3. A Space City has been proposed near Sriharikota.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements correctly describe initiatives associated with the Rayalaseema industrial hub.
accepted.tq: Check each project detail independently, especially the Phase-I and total investment figures.
accepted.sec: AP industrial infrastructure and ease of business - APIIC, Sri City, VCIC nodes, Single Desk, BRAP

accepted.s: The Andhra Pradesh Capital Region Development Authority (APCRDA) functions under which legislation?
o: AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020
accepted.x: APCRDA was established under the APCRDA Act, 2014. The AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 is relevant to Polavaram’s national-project status, not the constitution of APCRDA.
accepted.tq: Apply the wrong-Act trap by distinguishing similar year-and-subject legislation.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital - CRDA, phase-wise works

accepted.s: What amount was provided as the Budget Estimate for Amaravati in the Andhra Pradesh Budget 2024–25?
accepted.x: The Budget Estimate for Amaravati in 2024–25 was ₹3,000 crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the Amaravati allocation from the separate Polavaram allocation of ₹5,449 crore.
accepted.sec: Amaravati capital - CRDA, phase-wise works

accepted.s: Polavaram Project is located on the:
accepted.x: The Polavaram Project is located on the Godavari River.
accepted.tq: Use the river-project association rather than the district or funding details.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure projects - location/purpose (Polavaram, Bhogapuram, ports, Anakapalli, Kopparthy)

accepted.s:
With reference to the Polavaram Project, consider the following statements:
1. It is a national project under Section 90 of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014.
2. Its physical progress was 78.64 percent in December 2024.
3. Its target year of completion is 2027.
4. ₹5,449 crore was provided for it in the 2024–25 Budget Estimate.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct regarding Polavaram’s legal status, progress, target year and 2024–25 budget provision.
accepted.tq: Check the statutory provision, percentage, year and rupee figure as separate components.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure projects - location/purpose (Polavaram, Bhogapuram, ports, Anakapalli, Kopparthy)

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Mulapeta — Greenfield airport in Vizianagaram district
Bhogapuram — Greenfield international airport in Vizianagaram district
Kopparthy — Fishing harbour in Srikakulam district
Anakapalli — International airport in Krishna district
accepted.x: Bhogapuram is a greenfield international airport in Vizianagaram district. Mulapeta is a port in Srikakulam district, Kopparthy is an electronics cluster and NICP node, and Anakapalli is associated with a pharma hub.
accepted.tq: Find the correctly matched project, location and purpose while rejecting swapped identities.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure projects - location/purpose (Polavaram, Bhogapuram, ports, Anakapalli, Kopparthy)

accepted.s: The Ramayapatnam port is a greenfield port located on the:
accepted.x: Ramayapatnam is a greenfield port on the south coast of Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Identify the broad geographical location before considering the administrative details.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure projects - location/purpose (Polavaram, Bhogapuram, ports, Anakapalli, Kopparthy)

accepted.s: The limits of Ramayapatnam port were reduced from 51 km to:
accepted.x: The limits of Ramayapatnam port were reduced from 51 km to 15 km.
accepted.tq: Recall the before-and-after numerical pair rather than the nearby port figures.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure projects - location/purpose (Polavaram, Bhogapuram, ports, Anakapalli, Kopparthy)

accepted.s: The limits of Machilipatnam port were reduced from 64 km to 15 km under the:
o: AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020
accepted.x: The reduction in Machilipatnam port limits from 64 km to 15 km was made under the Indian Ports Act, 2025.
accepted.tq: Match the numerical change with the correct statutory authority.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure projects - location/purpose (Polavaram, Bhogapuram, ports, Anakapalli, Kopparthy)

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Kopparthy is in YSR Kadapa district and is associated with an electronics manufacturing cluster and an NICP node. It is not a greenfield international airport.
accepted.tq: Locate the single wrong project-purpose match among familiar Andhra Pradesh infrastructure projects.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure projects - location/purpose (Polavaram, Bhogapuram, ports, Anakapalli, Kopparthy)

accepted.s: Kopparthy, in YSR Kadapa district, is associated with which of the following?
o: A multi-product SEZ on the Tamil Nadu border
A major fishing harbour and a biofuel park
An electronics manufacturing cluster and an NICP node
A greenfield international airport and an aqua authority
accepted.x: Kopparthy is associated with an electronics manufacturing cluster and an NICP node in YSR Kadapa district.
accepted.tq: Use the location-purpose pair to distinguish Kopparthy from Sri City and Bhogapuram.
accepted.sec: AP infrastructure projects - location/purpose (Polavaram, Bhogapuram, ports, Anakapalli, Kopparthy)

accepted.s: Which of the following is included in the Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024?
o: Only nuclear power and tidal power
Only coal-based power and thermal storage
Solar, wind, hybrid energy, pumped storage and green hydrogen/ammonia
accepted.x: The policy covers solar, wind, hybrid energy, pumped storage, green hydrogen and ammonia, biofuels, storage and EV charging.
accepted.tq: Select the comprehensive policy basket and reject options using exclusive wording.
accepted.sec: AP energy, green and aqua policies - Clean Energy Policy, pumped storage, green hydrogen, Aqua Authority, fishing harbours

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024:
1. It targets 160 GW of clean energy.
2. It aims for net zero by 2047.
3. It seeks to make Andhra Pradesh a global green hydrogen hub.
4. It was launched in June 2024.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe the Integrated Clean Energy Policy, 2024.
accepted.tq: Verify the target, long-term objective, strategic ambition and launch timing separately.
accepted.sec: AP energy, green and aqua policies - Clean Energy Policy, pumped storage, green hydrogen, Aqua Authority, fishing harbours

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly represents the power-sector figures for Andhra Pradesh mentioned for APSES 2024–25?
o: Installed capacity 160,000 MW and renewable capacity 27,392 MW
Installed capacity 34,000 MW and renewable capacity 8,700 MW
Installed capacity 7,522 MW and renewable capacity 27,392 MW
Installed capacity 27,392 MW and renewable capacity 7,522 MW
accepted.x: The installed power capacity was 27,392 MW, of which renewable capacity was 7,522 MW.
accepted.tq: Avoid reversing the total installed-capacity and renewable-capacity figures.
accepted.sec: AP energy, green and aqua policies - Clean Energy Policy, pumped storage, green hydrogen, Aqua Authority, fishing harbours

accepted.s: In June 2026, land-related initiatives for solar and wind projects were reported in which districts of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Land was identified in Anantapur and Kadapa for solar and wind projects in June 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the district pair to distinguish renewable-energy land initiatives from project locations in the infrastructure table.
accepted.sec: AP energy, green and aqua policies - Clean Energy Policy, pumped storage, green hydrogen, Aqua Authority, fishing harbours

accepted.s: Which of the following statements is correct regarding green-building activity in Andhra Pradesh?
o: There are 627 projects covering 638 million square feet.
There are more than 638 IGBC projects covering 627.58 million square feet.
There are more than 1,000 projects covering 160 million square feet.
There are 638 projects covering exactly 627.58 thousand square feet.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh has more than 638 IGBC projects covering 627.58 million square feet.
accepted.tq: Read both the project count and area unit together; do not interchange them.
accepted.sec: AP energy, green and aqua policies - Clean Energy Policy, pumped storage, green hydrogen, Aqua Authority, fishing harbours

accepted.s: The AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020 primarily provides for regulation of:
o: Green buildings and EV charging stations
accepted.x: The Aqua Authority regulates aqua farms, aquaculture seed and aquaculture feed under the AP State Aquaculture Development Authority Act, 2020.
accepted.tq: Match the statute with its sector-specific regulatory functions.
accepted.sec: AP energy, green and aqua policies - Clean Energy Policy, pumped storage, green hydrogen, Aqua Authority, fishing harbours

accepted.s: Which of the following developments forms part of the current policy relevance of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Abolition of all industrial corridors through a single executive order
Replacement of the Single Desk Portal by a national tax tribunal
Cabinet clearance of the PPP Policy-2026 and Omnibus EoDB Act 2026 drafts
Transfer of APCRDA functions to the Aqua Authority
accepted.x: The Cabinet cleared the drafts of the PPP Policy-2026 and Omnibus EoDB Act 2026.
accepted.tq: Identify the genuine current-policy pair and reject institutional-function swaps.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s: Which one of the following best expresses the stated significance of the Rayalaseema industrial initiatives?
o: The region is being reserved exclusively for agricultural use.
The region is being converted into a single-purpose green-building zone.
The region is being developed only as a coastal port corridor.
The region is being transformed from a drought-prone area into an industrial hub.
accepted.x: The industrial initiatives signify Rayalaseema’s transformation from a drought-prone region into an industrial hub.
accepted.tq: Apply the broad regional-development objective to the described industrial projects.
accepted.sec: Universal angles

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Andhra Pradesh’s MSME and export position:
1. 2,61,393 MSMEs were set up in 2024–25.
2. Andhra Pradesh was ranked sixth in exports.
3. The number of MSMEs set up was 1,60,000.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh recorded 2,61,393 MSMEs set up in 2024–25 and ranked sixth in exports. Statement 3 gives an incorrect number.
accepted.tq: Check the exact count and rank while detecting the altered numerical distractor.
accepted.sec: Universal angles
